messages:
maria: quick share — ran a locality-aware scheduler sweep for mosaic-13b q2b on a mixed H100 + g8 cluster across us-west and eu-west.
maria: goal was to see if preferring local-cohort batching (same GPU type/region) reduces p95 without hurting throughput fairness.
maria: short summary: local batching + kernel_v2 gives best p50/p95 for short sequences, but kernel_v2 shows higher variance on long-tail (>=1024) tails in eu-west.
perf-bot: experiment artifacts: https://redwood-perf/reports/1738204567 — contains charts (latency by seq, throughput by region, fairness index)
evan: can you paste the main numbers here? quick eyeball.
maria: p50: 28ms (local+k2 H100), p95: 210ms; non-local avg p95: 310ms. throughput delta ~ -3% on steady-state for local+k2, fairness index improved from 0.72 -> 0.81.
kai: interesting. what's the behavior on g8 nodes? those smaller GPUs often flip the kernel preference.
maria: on g8 only: kernel_v1 p95 260ms, kernel_v2 p95 240ms for seq<256. but for seq >=1024 kernel_v1 p95=480ms, kernel_v2 p95=680ms (memory churn + kv eviction suspected).
sophia: do we have traces showing KV cache evictions or OOM-ish spikes? link?
maria: yes — trace snippets in the artifacts. short excerpt:

```
[H100-03] batch window=30ms, avg_batch_tokens=420, kv_cache_hit=0.87
[H100-03] kernel_v2: after seq 1024, mem-copy spikes -> stall 60-120ms
[G8-01] batch window=45ms, avg_batch_tokens=320, kv_cache_hit=0.74
```

dev-ops: noted. Could be kernel_v2's tiled attention path causing larger temp buffers on older card drivers. We should retest with nv driver 535 vs 520.
evan: any quality/quantization differences? this was q2b run right? maria: yes q2b. no observable regression in rouge/cls on our eval set (sampleset A). delta <0.3% on generation metrics.
kai: given memory spikes, maybe we adopt a hybrid policy: use kernel_v2 for seq<=512, fallback to kernel_v1 for long seqs and for G8 nodes. scheduler can implement rule:

```
if seq_len <= 512 and gpu_type == H100: prefer kernel_v2
elif gpu_type == G8: prefer kernel_v1
else: prefer kernel_v1
```

sophia: we should also consider increasing batch window by 10ms in eu-west to reduce long tail from network jitter — did we try a +10ms variant?
maria: yes — +10ms window reduced p95 on eu-west long-tail by ~40ms but increased p50 by ~5ms. tradeoff looks acceptable for customer-tiered policies.
evan: action items?
maria: 1) schedule follow-up sweep with driver 535 on a small cohort (H100+g8) — evan + dev-ops
2) add kernel selection rule to scheduler repo draft (kai)
3) run a q2b longtail regen eval to confirm no quality drift (sophia)
4) update perf doc with decision and recommended defaults (maria)

kai: I'll open the PR for scheduler rule and include config flags for per-region overrides.
perf-bot: rollout checklist created: https://redwood-ops/rollouts/1738204567
sophia: thanks — I'll queue the quality eval for tomorrow morning and post results here.
maria: thanks all. filing a short runbook note in the docs repo after PR merges. :thumbsup:
